priority_semantics: historical_priority is provenance only, not a change to current GitHub Project priorities
invariants: No running task, immutable admission, attempt, usage, unknown operation or original candidate is modified by this plan.
All source implementation uses Cursor Auto as primary; Codex fallback is prospective, explicit and never a permanent silent replacement.
A target model ID does not prove installed role qualification or provider quota.
A new substantive QA/CI failure goes to separate read-only Astra High diagnosis before the next permitted author repair.
Same unchanged candidate/findings reuse the completed diagnosis; unknown effects require reconciliation before any fallback.
DONE records do not receive a new author call; deferred records require authorized recovery, not reset.
Generated illustration is not a real venue photograph; generation/upload tools and operator rights are separate capabilities.
No PROD, runtime write, workflow dispatch or new task admission is authorized by this file.

Use existing accepted contract; one bounded unresolved-risk delta, not architecture restart.
Use task profile fallback only before known effects and within immutable allowance.
Separate read-only snapshot/session; inspect real tool errors and exact candidate, not final text alone.
Once per new failure fingerprint before bounded repair; completed brief reused; not author or ordinary QA.
Evidence-based public research, rights and venue identity; no model-generated claims of real photos.
Text CLI is not an image generator. No new paid provider or automatic spend authorized here.
Exact scope, rollback and real receipts; PROD needs separate GO.
Do not claim device PASS from model text or introduce new VPS-browser testing against Owner scope.
